description:
Video below of property. AVAILABLE 19th SEPTEMBER 2026.

It has an office on the bottom level and a garage to the rear of the property with new electric gates fitted. 

Fibre 500mb broadband super fast speeds

The house is a spacious 5 bedroom split level Bungalow with generous master bedroom with walk in wardrobe and four other double bedrooms, two of which have ensuites.  

It has an office on the bottom level and a garage to the rear of the property with new electric gates fitted.

The house has oil central heating and is currently decorated to a very high level with new kitchen fitted.

This property is comprising of, Marble floor entrance with two living room areas with kitchen and dining area.

The property has substantial gardens on a half acre site which are continuously maintained by a landscape gardener and parking on the property to cater for numerous guests.
